    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersTurin bagna caudaHot garlic and anchovy olive oil dip with fennel, peppers, radishes and breadHow to make it60g butter150ml extra virgin olive oil8 garlic cloves1 tin anchovies1 fennel bulb1 red capsicum1 bunch radishes1 crusty loafSlice the fennel, capsicum and radishes and the bread.Melt the butter in the oil over very low heat with crushed garlic and the anchovies until the anchovies dissolve.Keep warm over a candle and dip the vegetables and bread.Charlie Croker's cheese toastsToast bars topped with cheddar, parmesan and English mustard, grilled until bubblingHow to make it150g vintage cheddar30g parmesan1 tsp English mustard1 egg6 slices of white breadMix the grated cheddar and parmesan with the mustard and egg.Cut the bread into neat bars and toast one side.Spread the cheese mix on the other side.Grill until golden and bubbling.MainsPork with creamy tuna sauceCold poached pork loin sliced thin under a tuna, anchovy and caper mayoHow to make it800g pork loin185g tinned tuna3 anchovy fillets1 tbsp capers150g mayonnaise1 lemonPoach the pork gently in salted water until 63°C inside.Chill the pork.Blitz the tuna, anchovies, capers, mayonnaise and lemon juice until smooth.Slice the pork thin and cover with the sauce and more capers.Turin beef agnolotti with brown butterHandmade Piedmont pasta. Mr Bridger hopes you like spaghetti.How to make itAs written, serves 4Little pinched pasta pockets of braised beef and parmesan, tossed in nutty brown butter with crispy sage and more parmesan.Mix 300g shredded braised beef or cooked beef mince with 40g parmesan, 1 egg and nutmeg.Roll 400g fresh lasagne sheets thinner and cut into 6cm wide strips.Dot teaspoons of filling along each strip, fold over and pinch between each mound, then cut into pockets.Boil for 3 minutes.Melt 100g butter until nut brown with 12 sage leaves, toss the pasta through and finish with parmesan.SweetsBonet chocolate amaretti puddingCold baked custard with cocoa, amaretti and dark rum under a caramel topHow to make it250g caster sugar4 eggs500ml full cream milk2 tbsp cocoa powder80g amaretti biscuits30ml dark rumCook part of the sugar to a dark caramel and pour into a loaf tin.Whisk the eggs, remaining sugar, milk, cocoa, crushed amaretti and rum.Pour over and bake in a water bath at 160°C.Chill and turn out.DrinksCliffhanger hot chocolate and espressoHot chocolate topped with espresso and lightly whipped cream, in small glassesHow to make it300ml milk100g dark chocolate1 tbsp caster sugar4 espressos150ml thickened creamHeat the milk and whisk in the chopped chocolate and sugar until thick and smooth.Brew the espressos. Lightly whip the cream.Pour the hot chocolate into four small heatproof glasses.Gently pour an espresso over the back of a spoon on top, then float the cream. Serve without stirring.
